Unmanned Drone manufacturer Empirical Systems Aerospace acquired by AeroVironment - News March 16, 2026 Dan Taylor - Technology Editor, Military Embedded Systems AeroVironment, Inc. ARLINGTON, Virginia. AeroVironment has acquired Empirical Systems Aerospace, Inc. in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at about $200 million, adding engineering and manufacturing capacity in uncrewed aviation and propulsion, the company announced in a statement. Unmanned Directed energy and space manufacturing expansion planned in New Mexico by AeroVironment - News March 04, 2026 Dan Taylor - Technology Editor, Military Embedded Systems AeroVironment, Inc. ALBUQUERQUE, New Mexico. AeroVironment plans to invest more than $30 million to expand manufacturing across three existing sites in Albuquerque’s Sandia Science & Technology Park, the company announced in a statement. Unmanned Loitering munition systems to be supplied to U.S. Army by AeroVironment - News March 02, 2026 Dan Taylor - Technology Editor, Military Embedded Systems AeroVironment, Inc. ARLINGTON, Virginia. AeroVironment won a $186 million U.S. Army delivery order for Switchblade 600 Block 2 and Switchblade 300 Block 20 loitering munition systems, the company announced in a statement. Unmanned MOSA aligned systems for Army offered by Parry Labs and AeroVironment - News January 12, 2026 Lisa Daigle - Assistant Managing Editor, Military Embedded Systems Parry Labs AeroVironment, Inc. U.S. Army ALEXANDRIA, Va. Parry Labs announced it is teaming with AeroVironment to design, develop, and integrate modular open systems approach (MOSA) aligned digital engineering, software, and mission system hardware for the U.S. Army's P550 uncrewed aerial system (UAS), a key part of the Army's Long Range Reconnaissance (LRR) program. Unmanned Mobile counter-drone laser delivered to U.S. Army for prototyping - News December 19, 2025 Dan Taylor - Technology Editor, Military Embedded Systems AeroVironment, Inc. ARLINGTON, Virginia. AeroVironment delivered two Joint Light Tactical Vehicle (JLTV)-mounted mobile counter-uncrewed aerial system laser weapon systems to the U.S. Army under the second increment of the Army’s Multi-Purpose High Energy Laser (AMP-HEL) prototyping effort, the company announced in a statement. Unmanned Uncrewed system interoperability added to AV_Halo Command through OpenJAUS collaboration - News November 03, 2025 Dan Taylor - Technology Editor, Military Embedded Systems AeroVironment, Inc. ARLINGTON, Virginia. AeroVironment (AV) will integrate the Joint Architecture for Unmanned Systems (JAUS) standard into its AV_Halo Command software through a collaboration with OpenJAUS to enhance interoperability across uncrewed systems, the company announced in a statement. Unmanned Counter-UAS missile selected for U.S. Army long-range defense program - News October 23, 2025 Dan Taylor - Technology Editor, Military Embedded Systems AeroVironment, Inc. HUNTSVILLE, Alabama. AeroVironment won a $95.9 million contract to deliver its Freedom Eagle (FE-1) kinetic counter-uncrewed aircraft system (C-UAS) missile as part of the U.S. Army’s Long-Range Kinetic Interceptor (LRKI) program, the company announced in a statement.
